text.p: Fenerbahce club chairman Ali Sen has issued a general warning to his players after the dismissal of international defender Bulent Uygun for failing to get stuck into a former team-mate during a recent local 'derby'.

"Anyone who betrays Fenerbahce, whoever it is, will leave this team," Sen, known for his firm grip on Fenerbahce affairs, told a meeting of club directors. "For me the interests of Fenerbahce come before everything."

The Istanbul club announced on Sunday that it was to sell Uygun after he "behaved emotionally" by not doing enough to block former Fenerbahce player Oguz Cetin in a match against city rivals Istanbulspor.
Fenerbahce are currently lying second in Group C of the Champions' League with one match left and are also second in the domestic league.
